description: This file defines the main App component for a React application, including internal hooks for viewport detection, a desktop-only overlay component, and routing logic. It manages display based on viewport size and environment, and references external assets, hooks, and routing components.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom hook to detect if viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px), updating reactively on window resize.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React component displaying an overlay message indicating the app requires a desktop environment.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that conditionally renders routes or an overlay based on viewport size and environment.
